title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
titleNative: トクサツガガガ
synopsis: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize. Notes: Nominated to the 21st Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

title: Scary Book
titleNative: こわい本
synopsis: The spine-chilling influence of Japanese horror cinema has taken hold in Western audiences with hit films like The Ring that are based on Japanese films adapted from classic manga stories. And the master of horror manga is Umezu Kazuo-known as the "Stephen King of Japan," with several of his stories being adapted to film-and Dark Horse Manga is proud to bring his Scary Book horror anthology to Western readers for the first time. This first volume, Reflections, presents two feature-length tales of terror. In "Mirror," a narcissistic girl's reflection begins to take mean-spirited command of her life; and in "Demon's Revenge," a sadistic samurai master bent on seeking retribution for his son's injuries finds the tables of vengeance turned against him. (Source: Dark Horse)

synopsis: [I met him when I wanted to die.] Miyuki Saga worked part-time at a convenience store. Her eyes were always empty and unmoved. "I want to leave soon..." The person who appeared before her, the local famous yankee, x passive beautiful girl. "I didn't think it would be fun to just go through each day mindlessly." Miyuki was the target of bullying among the class girls. Abandoned to all forms of harassment, abuse and sometimes violence... "to combat them, I went to school automatically, and then I worked part-time at a convenience store. I just wanted to end this loop." However, Miyuki's monochrome daily life changed when she met Onitsuka, the leader of the delinquents. "Sometimes it's hard, but when I'm with this person, the world starts to shine."

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

title: Seibutsubu no Tanabe-kun

She works diligently everyday at the student council, honing her leadership skills with the goal of becoming Prime Minister someday. But then she runs into Seijiro Tanabe, the handsome but eccentric president of the Biology Club. Swept up by his passion for biological study, Sakura is about to experience the predatory side of Seijiro Tanabe's personality! (Source: Magapoke, translated)
